audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 4 and 6 disagreed with packet.levelChart (Skill/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Poppy/Yasuo) and with the whys.
audit.why: whys[0] says level 1 is neutral, whys[4] says level 6 keeps Poppy ahead, whys[6] says Yasuo out-scales hard. The chart said Poppy wins level 1, level 6 is even, and Poppy wins 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 4 and 6 flipped as matched full+content pairs with ratings updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].when reads 'Lvl 1' for a spike that depends on Steadfast Presence, while the early paragraph says level 1 is even because Poppy only has Q.
audit.why: The spike list also runs out of order (Lvl 2-3, then Lvl 1, then items).
audit.corrected: Should read Lvl 2. The field is under 25 characters so apply-proposals.js skips it — flagged for manual fix rather than proposed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) The whole page tells the user to track 'Sweeping Blade's cooldown' and engage when it is down — Sweeping Blade is 0.5s at rank 1 and 0.1s at rank 5. There is no cooldown window; the only restriction is that it cannot be recast on the same enemy for a few seconds. (b) Wind Wall was never mentioned, and Poppy's passive buckler toss is a projectile.
audit.why: A player waiting for a 0.1-second cooldown waits forever and never engages. The trackable cooldowns are Wind Wall (25/23/21/19/17s) and Last Breath (70/50/30s). Wind Wall blocks the buckler toss but not Q, E or R, which are not projectiles.
audit.corrected: Engage advice retargeted to Wind Wall and the per-target dash lockout; the Wind Wall interaction now stated explicitly.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every cooldown line pointed at Sweeping Blade, which has none worth tracking.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall's 25s and Last Breath's 70s now carry the sequencing advice.

notes: Biggest find: the page instructed the user to engage 'when Sweeping Blade is down'. Sweeping Blade's cooldown is 0.5s at rank 1 and 0.1s at rank 5 — there is no such window, only a per-target recast lockout. Retargeted to Wind Wall (25s) and Last Breath (70s). focus.text ('Yasuo Sweeping Blade') carries the same wrong premise but is 20 characters, under the applier's 25-character skip, so it needs a manual change to 'Yasuo Wind Wall'. Same skip blocks fixing spikes[1].when, which reads 'Lvl 1' but describes a level-2 spike.
